copy.failure: Could not copy the quote. Select the quote text to copy it manually, or try again.

save.failure: Could not save this quote. Try again.

notes.thisVideoEmpty: No notes for this video yet.

delete.failure: Could not delete this note. Retry.

play.sameVideo: Seek the current player to the note timestamp.
play.crossVideo: Open the note's existing timestamped URL in a new tab.

explain.close: Close removes only the visual modal; it does not cancel the request.
explain.staleResponse: A closed modal or an outdated video cannot receive a late response.

playback.active: Playback location uses a current row marker, time label, and play indicator.
playback.manualScroll: Manual scroll pauses following but does not remove the current playback marker.
playback.recovered: Follow playback restores scrolling without changing playback.
playback.reducedMotion: Follow scrolling uses auto when prefers-reduced-motion is reduce.
